newsitem.title: EGYPT: U.S. envoy Ross in Egypt to talk peace.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy Ross in Egypt to talk peace.

text.p: U.S. Middle East mediator Dennis Ross arrived on Saturday in a short visit to Cairo where he is expected to join a meeting with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and Palestinian leader Yasser Arafat.
Ross refused to talk to reporters on his arrivial at Cairo airport, airport sources said.
Mubarak and Arafat had started their meeting about an hour earlier at the presidential palace.
The U.S. envoy was accused by a senior official of Arafat's Palestinian Authority on Friday of abandoning his neutrality and showing bias toward Israel, the Washington Post reported.

The newspaper quoted Hanan Ashrawi as saying Ross's suggestion that Israel and the Palestinians agree to a withdrawal of Israeli troops from the occupied West Bank in 1998 amounted to a compromise that favoured Israel.
